New year 2024 is around the corner and it is time for resolutions. Every year, losing weight, eating healthy, and getting fit compete for our top resolutions. And by mid-January, the majority of those high-minded health goals have been abandoned, leaving us soured to the idea of positive change in the process. But it doesn't have to be this way. The problem is many healthy resolutions are too big and too vague to actually accomplish — so aim smaller and go specific. 

In support of the above, in this video I share with you 7 simple and healthy New Year resolutions that even the laziest of us can stick to.

Healthy New Year Resolution# 1 – Keep a water bottle handy, always. 

This is the bottle I use -  http://amzn.to/2hpfHko

Healthy New Year Resolution# 2 – Keep a healthy snack option with you.

Healthy New Year Resolution# 3 – Use an alternative to Sugar

Stevia Tablets -  http://amzn.to/2icLI0b
Stevia Sachets -  http://amzn.to/2i9Y2eZ

Healthy New Year Resolution# 4 – Use an alternative to Salt.

Rock Salt : http://amzn.to/2jskFdW
Black Salt : http://amzn.to/2hJvhor

Healthy New Year Resolution# 5 – Stop using electronic devices half an hour before you sleep.

Healthy New Year Resolution# 6 – Keep a hand sanitizer handy.

Hand Sanitizer : http://amzn.to/2iz4gYU

Healthy New Year Resolution# 7 – Try a new sport. 

Weren’t they simple?

Take a pick and let me know in the comments.

If you found this video helpful, do give it thumbs up. Share it with your friends.

SUBSCRIBE : https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYC6Vcczj8v-Y5OgpEJTFBw

I wish you a very happy and healthy New Year 2017 :)
